symbols.name: first space
symbols.quote: Let $E$ and $F$ be vector spaces over $\mathbb{C}$.

symbols.name: second space
symbols.quote: Let $E$ and $F$ be vector spaces over $\mathbb{C}$.

symbols.name: general vector of E
symbols.quote: Every $e\in E$ is a general vector of $E$, and every $f\in F$ a general vector of $F$.

symbols.name: general vector of F
symbols.quote: Every $e\in E$ is a general vector of $E$, and every $f\in F$ a general vector of $F$.

symbols.name: basis vector of E
symbols.quote: Let $e_1,\dots,e_p$ be a basis of $E$ and $f_1,\dots,f_q$ a basis of $F$, where $e_i$ is the $i$th basis vector of $E$, $f_j$ the $j$th of $F$, $p$ and $q$ are the numbers of basis vectors, and $1\le i\le p$, $1\le j\le q$.

symbols.name: basis vector of F
symbols.quote: Let $e_1,\dots,e_p$ be a basis of $E$ and $f_1,\dots,f_q$ a basis of $F$, where $e_i$ is the $i$th basis vector of $E$, $f_j$ the $j$th of $F$, $p$ and $q$ are the numbers of basis vectors, and $1\le i\le p$, $1\le j\le q$.

symbols.name: basis count of E
symbols.meaning: The number of basis vectors of $E$, its dimension.
symbols.quote: Let $e_1,\dots,e_p$ be a basis of $E$ and $f_1,\dots,f_q$ a basis of $F$, where $e_i$ is the $i$th basis vector of $E$, $f_j$ the $j$th of $F$, $p$ and $q$ are the numbers of basis vectors, and $1\le i\le p$, $1\le j\le q$.

symbols.name: basis count of F
symbols.meaning: The number of basis vectors of $F$, its dimension.
symbols.quote: Let $e_1,\dots,e_p$ be a basis of $E$ and $f_1,\dots,f_q$ a basis of $F$, where $e_i$ is the $i$th basis vector of $E$, $f_j$ the $j$th of $F$, $p$ and $q$ are the numbers of basis vectors, and $1\le i\le p$, $1\le j\le q$.

symbols.name: basis index of E
symbols.meaning: The index of a basis vector $e_i$, running from $1$ to $p$.
symbols.quote: Let $e_1,\dots,e_p$ be a basis of $E$ and $f_1,\dots,f_q$ a basis of $F$, where $e_i$ is the $i$th basis vector of $E$, $f_j$ the $j$th of $F$, $p$ and $q$ are the numbers of basis vectors, and $1\le i\le p$, $1\le j\le q$.

symbols.name: basis index of F
symbols.meaning: The index of a basis vector $f_j$, running from $1$ to $q$.
symbols.quote: Let $e_1,\dots,e_p$ be a basis of $E$ and $f_1,\dots,f_q$ a basis of $F$, where $e_i$ is the $i$th basis vector of $E$, $f_j$ the $j$th of $F$, $p$ and $q$ are the numbers of basis vectors, and $1\le i\le p$, $1\le j\le q$.

symbols.name: map on E
symbols.quote: Let $S$ be a linear map of $E$ and $T$ of $F$.

symbols.name: map on F
symbols.quote: Let $S$ be a linear map of $E$ and $T$ of $F$.

symbols.name: selected-bit count
symbols.meaning: The number of selected address bits that the layer acts on.
symbols.quote: Here $D$ counts the selected bits, not the address field $D$.

symbols.name: butterfly
symbols.meaning: The two-point butterfly map, given by a $2\times 2$ matrix on $(u,v)$.
symbols.quote: The butterfly $H_0$ is the $2\times 2$ matrix $\tfrac12\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&-1\end{pmatrix}$ acting on column vectors $\begin{pmatrix}u\\v\end{pmatrix}$.

relations.quote: The tensor product of one-dimensional transforms is built from one [Discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md) per axis.
